sources.supports: The island has red chinchompas on the hill east of town, tropical wagtails, black warlocks east of Sacred Grove, and orange salamanders on northwest Abalone Cliffs.

Locations include Great Conch for red chinchompas, tropical wagtails and orange salamanders; Chinchompa Island for red chinchompas; Burrow for moonlight antelope; Fossil Island herbiboar Hunter80/Herblore31/Bone Voyage.
Burrow is underground beneath Hunter Guild. Southern caverns contain moonlight moths and antelope.
Hunter65 net/jar, barehand75; reduced stats except Prayer restored, 8 HP healed. Found Avium Savannah/Neypotzli; NPC12770.
Hunter75 net/jar, barehand85; basement of Hunter Guild, Neypotzli, Ruins of Tapoyauik and Tonali Cavern; NPC12771/12772/12773.
Jar release restores22 Prayer. Multicombat sharing needs Accept Aid; item28893.
Level39 box trap; NPC13139. Spawns west of guild and northwest of Locus Oasis; drops jerboa tail. Partial Eagles Peak for catching, completion for rumour assignment.
Wild ferrets northwest of mountain; article says quest completion needed for them and rabbits.
Changes table says partial completion permits box traps since28June2018; quest catches ferret before completion.
Partial Eagles Peak for box traps; table lists ferret27 with no extra restriction.
Historical island design lists grey chinchompas, copper longtails and crimson swifts. Fresh page access does not make historical design current exhaustive spawn evidence.
